ns0:section.ns0:heading: Inclusion in National Incident-Based Reporting System

ns0:content.ns0:p: Not later than 2 years after September 13, 1994, the Attorney General, in accordance with the States, shall compile data regarding domestic violence and intimidation (including stalking) as part of the National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS).

ns0:note.ns0:heading: Codification
ns0:note.ns0:p: Section was formerly classified to section 14038 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
